title: CSCI 471 — Professional Communications
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Students will define the core ethical principles outlined in the ACM Code of Ethics.
Students will identify stakeholder analysis as a method for evaluating ethical computing decisions.
Students will apply ethical decision-making frameworks to real-world technical scenarios.
